Name: Verdant Glade Farm
Author: SilverVenthil
Description:
Verdant Glade farm is a custom farm map designed to evoke the feeling of a tranquil clearing in the woods proper rather than the forests edge of the base game forest farm. scattered about the farm are old hearty trees that grow things like Spice berries, Crystal Fruit or other similar foragables as provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30150]Vanilla Forage Trees[/url] by Syanide to act as an extension of the ground forage that spawns on sunny days. with a variety of shaded areas that don't start available but grow extra foragables during and immediately after a rainy day, one of these glades spawns Seasonal Flowers on any sunny or windy day.

the map features cross mod compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry [/url]in the form of its forage that appears in the Secret Woods and Cindersap forest appearing on the farm, mushrooms appear rarely on sunny days, and more frequently the day of and after it rains.

If you run this map alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]More Flowers[/url] additional fruit trees will be scattered about the farm from those mods, Lemon, Lime, Star Anise, Elderberry and Wild Cocoa from Wildflour's Atelier, Jasmine, Magnolia, Fig, Cinnamon and Nutmeg from Cornucopia. these also have to be enabled in the config for those mods in order to appear on the map.

Additional config to choose what farm animal you start with is available via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], like the thematic of a sheep grazing by the meadows riverside? you can choose to start with a sheep, you do still start with a basic Barn and not the upgraded one you'd normally have to have to buy one. whatever animal you choose you'll start with the tool required to harvest their produce. additionally this config supports starting with a Pokemon barn and a selection of animals from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24619]Pokemon Ranch[/url] by Plaidbees.

Not required by any means, but due to the farm map including a variety of fruit trees, i would generally recomend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11422]Fruit Tree Tweaks[/url] with a wider range of fruit per day, 0 for the min and 2 for the max is what i use personally, with trees being allowed up to 6 total at once. mostly to help keep the foraging feel, since you know where the spice berry tree is on the farm but have to check most days to get the fruit from them since its not a consistent amount per day.

Notes - this farm map is intended for play alongside the listed cross compatibility mods, but should work in any combination of things the only content requirement being Vanilla Forage trees to have Spice Berry, Crystal Fruit, Holly, Wild Plum and Hazelnut trees initally on the farm.

If Custom Bush ever updates to allow placing tea bushes onto maps like fruit trees odds are the layout will get an update to start with things like strawberry bushes in its blocked off glades and replacing stuff like the crystal fruit trees with bushes possibly modded content cross compatibility on that front as well.
